title: The Cake Invitation
context: You are at an excessively formal cake tasting. The host offers you the first slice. Decide whether to accept or politely decline.

lines.text: That is a very special cake.
I made it just for you.

baselineDirection: Warm, naturally proud of your baking and genuinely welcoming. Address a guest casually. Keep the words exact and the delivery understated.

title: The Extremely Normal Exhibition
context: You manage a tiny museum. Its team has prepared tonight's new display and sent this announcement. Decide whether to open it to guests or request a rehearsal first.
baselineDirection: A competent museum colleague giving an ordinary update. Natural conversational pacing, restrained warmth, settled and ready. Avoid exaggerated cheerfulness, ominous effects and added words.

title: The Galactic Gala
context: You are booking a host for the Galactic Gala, an absurdly formal awards night. This is an applicant's short audition. Decide whether to book them or keep looking.

lines.text: I have something planned for everyone.
This should be a memorable evening.

baselineDirection: Formal and slightly distant, with measured pacing and restrained warmth. Make the anticipation mildly difficult to read. Avoid an overt villain voice, a conspicuous whisper, an obvious laugh or added words.
